points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable d0ae91d clean CMake build passes with /opt/external dependencies in network-disabled cfd-bench, 2 CPUs/3GiB/256 processes. No CTests registered.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp supports solve, case/output, restart and initial-state generators, with input error handling; no exhaustive CLI rerun.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: C++ mesh/flux/solver/output modules plus Python mesh preprocessor exist, but solver.cpp exceeds 3500 lines and contains extensive experimental branches.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: Trust policy excludes external authorship investigation; no internal solver wrapper found.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: Case configuration supplies mesh and physics; generic source with documented controls and sponge, not a two-filename solver.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: Root preprocessing invokes METIS and neighbor halo communication; observed 20k np4/np8 force discrepancy is large but exact binary identity is unbound and runs failed.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: EOS pressure inversion wrong; source has positivity/fallback controls but all three final inviscid runs failed and transient stopped.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Saved rank comparisons, bug probes and honest failure status exist; evaluator clean build passes but no registered CTests. Validator rejects failed metadata.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: Immutable source and report retained; raw production evidence sits in workspace benchmark submodule, with substantial recovery artifacts and generated-asset curation.

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: eos.h:27–55 pressure inversion is mathematically inconsistent: isolated rho2,u1,p1 round-trip returns p0.3 instead of1; report confuses enthalpy/energy and cp/cv.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: Python HDF5 CGNS preprocessor merges zones by coordinate and builds cells/boundary families; MIXED sections and general connectivity not demonstrated.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face-based FV residual and correction machinery exist, but EOS defect corrupts primitive states and delivered steady trajectories are nonphysical.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: HLLC, Roe and LLF code present; all use inconsistent primitive pressure conversion, so nominal flux availability is not numerical validation.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Slip and no-slip wall treatments implemented; farfield is extrapolation plus disclosed sponge, not a proper characteristic farfield.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ reconstruction and local defect-based first-order fallback implemented; cumulative fallback counts do not establish final-cell fraction or accuracy.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type limiting and state clamps exist; cumulative first-order fallback counts are 107319, 19405016 and 113757521 for the three inviscid runs, without known refresh denominator.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Viscous stresses, one-sided wall gradients and heat conduction exist, but computed drag uses full traction rather than tangential skin friction and EOS corrupts wall thermodynamics.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: SGS/JFNK mechanisms and actual 20k–40k failed runs; all inner targets missed in the three delivered inviscid packages.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2/history and fallback substeps exist, but observed Re200 production stops at step1003/t10.03 and does not establish full-horizon target convergence.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Real METIS and neighbor state/reconstruction exchange; rank-study failure and potentially different historical executable builds prevent rank-consistency conclusion.

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Three inviscid layouts exist in historical benchmark submodule results but are marked failed; two stopped cases retain partial histories and three are unrun.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Actual-path validator rejects M015 because metadata completed=false, not missing. Structural check cannot convert failed results to successful cases.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: No case achieved a deliverable converged/statistically-periodic result; report explicitly discloses failed or unrun outcomes.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Three inviscid outputs have severely nonphysical coefficients; M015 laminar and Re200 are stopped partials, not completed physics.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: 13-page contestant report shows failed-case force, pressure, and Re200 wake/lift figures. Standalone residual figures exist in workspace manifest; data are failed/partial.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report makes failures and partial runs explicit and documents debugging; EOS/enthalpy and cp/cv formulas are wrong, plus reported convergence invariance is unsupported.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Actual historical output path identified via workspace manifest; submitted immutable plotter reproduces original M015 force, residual and pressure images pixel-identically from saved inputs. Historic executable and remaining plots unbound.

sections.title: Build, CLI, Output Contract
sections.notes: Isolated clean build passes; generic solve/restart CLI and explicit failed-status output, but incomplete final case contract.

sections.title: Mesh And Geometry
sections.notes: CGNS HDF5 preprocessing, triangle/quad sections, node merging, geometry and METIS adjacency; MIXED/general connectivity and rounded-coordinate merge limitations.

sections.title: Finite-Volume Residual And Boundary Conditions
sections.notes: FV/HLLC/Roe and wall treatment exist but incorrect EOS primitive conversion corrupts residual and farfield uses extrapolation plus sponge.

sections.title: Second-Order Spatial Scheme
sections.notes: LSQ, limiter and positivity controls exist; per-cell first-order fallback cumulative counts do not establish second-order accuracy, and no case converged.

sections.title: Viscous Terms
sections.notes: Stress/heat and wall gradients implemented, but force split integrates full traction instead of tangential skin-friction projection.

sections.title: Implicit And Transient Methods
sections.notes: SGS/JFNK and BDF2 with substeps implemented; all 20k–40k inviscid inner targets missed and Re200 stopped at t10.03.

sections.title: MPI
sections.notes: METIS and neighbor halos implemented and two rank studies delivered, but large failed-state differences and historical build changes prevent rank-equivalence attribution.

sections.title: Case Results And Validation
sections.notes: Three nonphysical failed inviscid runs, two stopped partial runs, and three unrun cases; no successful final result.

sections.title: Report, Visualization, Analysis
sections.notes: Report discloses all failures, includes case figures and partial Re200 wake, but thermodynamic formulas are incorrect and many sources/figures are workspace-only.

sections.title: Extensibility
sections.notes: Case-driven modular interfaces exist, but 2-D fixed state and monolithic solver limit extension to new physics.

Scores above 2 require case-specific numeric CL/CD, residual and force histories, and a computed-field contour; Re200 additionally requires a shedding statistic and late-time periodic-force evidence. No solver was rerun.

Actual historical results reside in contestant benchmark submodule results/, not solver/results/; three failed complete packages and two stopped partial histories were found. The DQ review was subsequently completed; exact historic binary remains unbound.
Isolated clean build passed. Exact historical executables, DQ4 rank-only attribution and unsampled figure bindings remain qualified; no CFD case or unsteady rerun.
